purpose: Qualify the smallest source-reviewed Obsidian zoom-map surface that can carry several human-selected image regions into the existing Hermes visual-focus skill without creating a Pantheon sidecar schema, annotation authority or second vision runtime.

rules: zoom-map UX sidecar != document routing persistence

storage.note: The upstream README documents JSON sidecar storage beside the image, with optional inline-note storage. This pilot uses JSON only.

geometry.v0_reason: Rectangle drawing coordinates are directly reusable as a normalized bounding box and map exactly to Hermes region semantics. Other drawing kinds remain deferred until an Obsidian runtime smoke confirms the desired conversion policy.

candidate_profile.name: sidecar_read_only_rect_to_visual_focus
candidate_profile.input: exact source image plus adjacent zoom-map markers JSON
candidate_profile.selection_rule: read visible rect drawings only from the explicitly selected Hermes Focus draw layer
candidate_profile.mapping_rule: multiply normalized x coordinates by exact source width and normalized y coordinates by exact source height; order min/max and clamp to source bounds before invoking vision_analyze.region
candidate_profile.sidecar_posture: external plugin UX state only; not a Pantheon production sidecar, document routing persistence, currentness owner, Evidence store, Project Anatomy store or governed identity carrier

cases.expected: The three visible rect drawings in Hermes Focus map deterministically to three original-image pixel bboxes suitable for vision_analyze.region.
A visible reference rectangle on another draw layer is not included merely because it exists in the same sidecar.
The fixture image digest matches the recorded source before any saved region is reused; a replacement image must not silently inherit old focus coordinates.
zoom-map 2.2.8 in an isolated Obsidian vault can create and persist equivalent rectangle selections without mutating the source image.

An authorized Hermes runtime can consume the exact synthetic source plus selected pixel regions through visual-focus / vision_analyze.region while preserving whole-image context and without promoting output to Evidence.

execution_gate.source_review_can_prove: The reviewed zoom-map release has adjacent JSON storage, structured drawing layers and rectangle geometry compatible with a deterministic normalized-to-pixel mapping fixture.
execution_gate.source_review_cannot_prove: That the target Obsidian installation emits the exact expected sidecar after interactive use, that configuration drift cannot alter behavior, or that the deployed Hermes profile is installed and task-authorized to analyze the source.
execution_gate.required_runtime_smoke: Install zoom-map 2.2.8 in an isolated Obsidian test vault, open the synthetic SVG, create three rectangles on a Hermes Focus layer, compare the emitted JSON and source hash with this fixture, then run one authorized Hermes visual-focus analysis over at least two selected regions.
execution_gate.register_placement: Do not add zoom-map to the external-tool placement register as a qualified candidate until the runtime smoke is observed and reviewed.
execution_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat source review, sidecar existence, plugin installation, successful crop analysis or a drawing label as Evidence, governed identity, professional validation or production sidecar admission.
